# Spigot Commands and Permissions
[](https://www.spigotmc.org/wiki/) Mar 30, 2024
  * [Discussion (8)](https://www.spigotmc.org/threads/spigot-commands-and-permissions.2651/unread)


  * [Page](https://www.spigotmc.org/wiki/spigot-commands/#wikiContent)
  * [History](https://www.spigotmc.org/wiki/spigot-commands/#history)
  * [Editors](https://www.spigotmc.org/wiki/spigot-commands/#editors)


  * Spigot Commands and Permissions
Additional commands provided by Spigot
* * *
  

For a reference of Minecraft/Vanilla commands, click [**here**](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Commands).  
For a reference of Bukkit commands, click **[here](https://bukkit.fandom.com/wiki/CraftBukkit_Commands)**.
`/restart`   
**Permission node** : bukkit.command.restart  
_This command will attempt to perform a server restart. In order for this to work, you must have the_**"restart-script"**_value properly defined in_[spigot.yml](https://www.spigotmc.org/wiki/spigot-configuration-spigot-yml/) _._  
**Default** : Operator  
  
`/tps`   
**Permission node** : bukkit.command.tps  
_This command will show TPS (_ ticks per second _) averages of your server from the last 1, 5, and 15 minutes._  
**Default** : Operator  
  
`/timings on` _([disabled between builds #1261-#1537](https://www.spigotmc.org/wiki/disabled-timings-on-command/))_  
**Permission node** : bukkit.command.timings  
_This command will turn on server benchmark timings, without requiring a restart._  
**Default** : Operator  
  
`/timings off` _([disabled between builds #1319-#1537](https://www.spigotmc.org/wiki/disabled-timings-on-command/))_  
**Permission node** : bukkit.command.timings  
_This command will turn off server benchmark timings, without requiring a restart._  
**Default** : Operator  
  
`/timings merged`   
**Permission node** : bukkit.command.timings  
_This command will write server benchmark timings to disk. A text file named_ timingsX.txt _will be stored in the_ /timings/_directory, where_ X _increases in single increments each time._  
**Default** : Operator  
  
`/timings separate`   
**Permission node** : bukkit.command.timings  
_This command will produce timings reports for active plugins, but rather in separate text files for each one._  
**Default** : Operator  
  
`/timings paste`   
**Permission node** : bukkit.command.timings  
_Instead of writing to file, all server benchmark timings will be uploaded to[SpigotMC Timings](https://timings.spigotmc.org/)._  
**Default** : Operator  
  
`/timings reset`   
**Permission node** : bukkit.command.timings  
_This command will reset previous data gathered by the server benchmark timings._  
**Default** : Operator
